items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was reading about the first time that Hande performed his blues in the song... [INTERVIEWEE] But you know his blues wasn't like that old down blues.

ctx.x: Because some of them fellas used to come holler, you understand? Play that blues, so and so, play that blues. And then I just, ta ta dee, ta ta dee, ta ta dee, ta ta da da. Just like that. You see I knew like the tune. We played the tune. But I've never seen no music of that.

I was reading about the first time that Hande performed his blues in the song. One of the clubs in Memphis. They said, my goodness when he hit that thing. Boy, and gave a few, I mean that rhythm, set up that blues rhythm and so on. They said those people went wow.

But you know his blues wasn't like that old down blues. You said? No. No, not the real. His blues, ta da dee dee, ta da da dee dee, ta da da dee dee, you see? Yes. Then ta da da dum, ta da dum, ta da dum, you know? That's right. But not this down blues. Uh huh. These down blues go, ta da dee, ta da dee, ta da dee da da da da da dee, da da. You see? That old down blues go. And then you could compose it, put anything you want in it, you see? You could even put, ta da da da da da da da da da da da da da da da da da…
